items.title: 2 S&P 500 Stocks with Impressive Fundamentals and 1 We Turn Down

items.title: Barclays sees a $3.6 trillion annual investment opportunity in this sector
items.summary: Investing.com -- The global energy sector could require about $3.6 trillion of annual investment by 2027 as artificial intelligence, electrification and energy-security concerns drive demand faster than supply and infrastructure can respond, Barclays analysts said.
